terms.label: COSMOS
terms.definition: COSMOS-standard, owned and managed by COSMOS-standard AISBL; certificates are issued by authorised certification bodies (name it in `issuer`).

terms.label: Ecocert
terms.definition: Ecocert is a certification body (Ecocert Group), not a single standard. For a COSMOS certificate issued by Ecocert use `cosmos` with Ecocert as `issuer`; use this key only for a certificate to an Ecocert-owned standard and name it in `edition` or `reference`.

terms.label: NATRUE
terms.definition: NATRUE Label of The International Natural and Organic Cosmetics Association (NATRUE).

terms.label: USDA Organic
terms.definition: USDA National Organic Program (7 CFR Part 205).

terms.label: EU organic farming
terms.definition: Organic production and labelling of organic products under Regulation (EU) 2018/848.

terms.label: Fair trade
terms.definition: Generic fair-trade certification; name the scheme and body in `issuer` and `reference`.

terms.label: Halal
terms.definition: Halal certification; certifying bodies differ by country. Name the body in `issuer`.

terms.label: Kosher
terms.definition: Kosher certification; name the certifying agency in `issuer`.

terms.label: Vegan
terms.definition: Supplier's own declaration that the material contains no animal-derived ingredients. A third-party certificate is `vegan_society_trademark` or another scheme named in `issuer`.

terms.label: The Vegan Society Vegan Trademark
terms.definition: The Vegan Trademark, a third-party vegan certification scheme of The Vegan Society (since 1990).

terms.label: RSPO Mass Balance
terms.definition: RSPO supply chain model Mass Balance: certified and conventional palm material mixed, with certified volumes administratively tracked.

terms.label: RSPO Segregated
terms.definition: RSPO supply chain model Segregated: certified palm material from several certified sources, kept separate from conventional material.

terms.label: RSPO Identity Preserved
terms.definition: RSPO supply chain model Identity Preserved: certified palm material from a single identifiable certified source, kept separate from conventional material throughout the supply chain.

terms.label: RSPO Book and Claim (RSPO Credits)
terms.definition: RSPO Book and Claim (RSPO Credits): credits bought from RSPO-certified growers, crushers or independent smallholders; no physical certified material in the supply chain.

terms.label: FSC
terms.definition: Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) certification.

terms.label: ISO 22716 (cosmetic GMP) certification
terms.definition: Certification of a site to ISO 22716:2007 (Cosmetics, Good Manufacturing Practices) by a certification body.

terms.label: EFfCI GMP
terms.definition: EFfCI GMP certification scheme for cosmetic ingredients (European Federation for Cosmetic Ingredients); based on the EFfCI GMP Guide, audited by independent certification bodies as an extension of ISO 9001.

terms.label: ISO 16128 natural-origin statement
terms.definition: Calculated natural / organic origin indexes under ISO 16128-1 and ISO 16128-2. These are guidelines: there is no ISO 16128 certification, so this is a declaration.

terms.label: EcoVadis rating
terms.definition: EcoVadis sustainability rating (a rating, not a certification).

terms.label: Leaping Bunny (Cruelty Free International)
terms.definition: Cruelty Free International approval programme (Leaping Bunny logo); covers animal-testing policy, not vegan status.

terms.label: California Proposition 65
terms.definition: California Safe Drinking Water and Toxic Enforcement Act of 1986 (Proposition 65).

terms.label: Nagoya Protocol / ABS compliance
terms.definition: Access and benefit-sharing under the Nagoya Protocol (in the EU, Regulation (EU) No 511/2014).

terms.label: EU Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009
terms.definition: Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009 on cosmetic products; give the annex and entry in `reference`.

terms.label: EU REACH
terms.definition: Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH).

terms.label: US FDA OTC monograph
terms.definition: US FDA OTC drug monograph (for example M020, sunscreen drug products); give the monograph and order in `reference`.

terms.label: US MoCRA
terms.definition: US Modernization of Cosmetics Regulation Act of 2022.
